name: Kokoro-chan no☆Himitsu Shinryou File
original_name: こころちゃんの☆秘密診療ファイル
source:
Main character gets hospitalized as a result of traffic incident on his first day in the university. He has both arms and legs injured. But there's a good point in it as well - nurses in this hospital are unbelievably cute!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在大学入学第一天便遭遇交通事故，结果住进了医院。他的双臂和双腿都受了伤。不过，这件事也有好的一面——这家医院的护士可爱得令人难以置信！

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
